reviews.title: Almost good
reviews.text:
I use opera GX on my laptop as a primary browser. On PC it’s a great application, simple to use, and good for my use case. However on my phone; not so much. 

If I close my phone and there’s a video playing it will continue to play. Sometimes if I pause the video it will randomly start to play again a few minutes later. 

It’s a clunky app to navigate all the functionality. It just needs some polishing and it’ll be my go-to browser but for now. Stick with Chrome
